integrity: The starting mean-time expression is credited to the cited primary literature; newly proved claims are unique optimizer, strict all-magnitude orientation ordering and fixed-reactivity strong-drift offset. Numerical tests support, but do not establish, universal proof.
scientific_limitations: One full-line one-dimensional constant-drift Brownian diffusion, a single finite-strength local-time delta sink, independent homogeneous Poisson resetting to one point. Strong-drift expansions hold for fixed positive diffusivity, distance and finite reactivity; no joint perfect-absorption limit, nonlinear drift or multi-target claim.
title: Unique optimal resetting and a finite-reactivity drift-orientation gap
